title: M5Stack Tough · K034
summary: ESP32工业触摸终端，2英寸320×240 IPS屏、RS485及四路Grove接口，面向防尘防溅水外壳应用。

facts.label: SoC
facts.value: ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 @ Xtensa® 32-bit LX6 dual-core processor, clock frequency 240MHz

facts.label: Interfaces
facts.value: USB Type-C x 1, HY2.0-4P x 4 (RS485 / I2C / GPIO / UART interfaces)

facts.label: IPS LCD
facts.value: 2.0" 320 x 240 ILI9342C full-color display, max brightness 853 nits

facts.label: LCD & microSD
facts.notes: 2026-11-22 official page row reads AXP_IO4 / AXP_LDO3 / AXP_LDO2 for ILI9342C RST / BL / PWR. The 2026-10-26 revision of the same page read AXP_DC3, which is the Core2 K010 mapping; the schematic export (created 2021-01-22) shows AXP192 U4 pin 11 = LDO3 and pin 42 = GPIO4 on net LCD_RST, so LDO3 for the backlight and GPIO4 for the reset are the values kept here.

facts.label: IPS display
facts.notes: Official specification table. M5GFX lists the panel as runtime-selectable between ili9342c (default) and ili9342e with rotation_offset 0, so the mounted part is not fixed by the board definition.

facts.label: LCD SPI pins
facts.notes: Official PinMap "LCD & microSD" row plus M5GFX dev:lcd.cs=G5, dev:lcd.dc=G15 and the LCD1/FPC nets GPIO5 (CS) and GPIO15 (DC).

facts.label: LCD SPI bus configuration
facts.notes: M5GFX board spec main_spi entry; the values are marked "generated" in that file, so they describe the reference driver configuration, not a measured rail.

facts.label: LCD reset / backlight / power control
facts.notes: Conflict recorded: M5GFX m5tough.json maps pmic gpio3 -> dev:lcd.rst (that pin block carries no "verified" marker), while the official page says AXP_IO4 and the schematic shows AXP192 U4 pin 42 = GPIO4 on net LCD_RST. The official page plus schematic are used here; the M5GFX mapping is left as an open question for the driver.

facts.label: LCD + touch module interface
facts.notes: Altium text export of the main schematic; the module is named CORE2_LCD, i.e. Tough reuses the Core2 display/touch assembly. Pin 8 and the shield net were ambiguous in the text layer and are not claimed.

facts.label: Capacitive touch controller
facts.notes: Not a resistive XPT2046 panel: the current and 2026-10-26 official pages, and M5GFX part "chsc6540", all name an I2C capacitive controller at 0x2E.

facts.label: Touch I2C and interrupt

value.int: G39 (driven low when a touch is pending)
value.rst: shared with the LCD on AXP192 AXP_IO4

facts.notes: M5Touch::begin() does Wire1.begin(21,22), pinMode(39, INPUT), writes register 0x5A=0x5A to select interrupt mode and reads the INT level with digitalRead(39)==LOW. The main schematic has a single LCD_RST net, so the panel reset is shared with the LCD rather than on a separate AXP output.

facts.label: Touch coordinate range
facts.notes: Conflict recorded: the deprecated M5Tough library defines TOUCH_W 320 / TOUCH_H 280 (M5Touch.h line 235-236), while the official panel and M5GFX clamp the reported maximum to 319x239. Which raw range the CHSC6540 reports on shipped units is unverified; the board model uses 320x240.

facts.label: Front panel buttons

value.implementation: CHSC6540 touch zones below the three printed circles; no ESP32 GPIO

facts.notes: M5Tough README ("The 3 icons on the front of the screen are capacitive buttons which are programmable") and M5Button.h line 162-164 ("the three buttons M5.BtnA, M5.BtnB and M5.BtnC ... come already implemented as touch buttons"). The rectangles are the rotation-1 zones used by the deprecated library (M5Button.h line 268-273); the current official page has no button table, so the zone geometry is library-derived and not an official dimension.

facts.label: Power button
facts.notes: M5GFX models btn_pwr with active_low and pull "pmic", driven by pmic pin pwrkey. The library README says there is an independent power button on the left side of the base. No ESP32 GPIO is involved, so a guest sketch cannot read it as an input pin.

facts.label: Reset input

value.usb_auto_reset: CH9102/CP2104 DTR-RTS through Q1/Q2 also drives MCU_RST

facts.notes: Official PinMap rows "HY2.0_RESET" and "M5-Bus", plus the Ext Board schematic (J7 = HY-2.0_RESET, pin 1 EN, pin 2 G25) and the main schematic MCU_RST net. The library README mentions an independent reset button on the bottom of the base; the button itself is not drawn in the audited text layer.

facts.label: Speaker / I2S amplifier
facts.notes: Official PinMap "MIC & NS4168" rows plus M5GFX i2s_spk (bck 12, ws 0, data_out 2) and pmic gpio2 -> dev:speaker.enable. The Ext Board schematic shows the SPK_EN net on AXP192 U4 pin 20 = GPIO2.

facts.label: Microphone
facts.notes: Official PinMap row (MIC CLK on G0, DATA on G34) and M5GFX pdm_mic (ws 0, data_in 34). No microphone part number is published on the product page.

facts.label: AXP192 power path
facts.notes: Schematic pin-to-name pairs verified in the Altium export: U4 pin 11 = LDO3, 12 = LDO2, 17 = DCDC3, 18 = GPIO1, 19 = BUS_PW_EN, 20 = GPIO2, 40 = EXTEN, 41 = GPIO3, 42 = GPIO4 (net LCD_RST), 44 = VIN1, 45 = LX1, 47 = DCDC1 (net MCU_VDD). M5GFX additionally labels ldo2 as pwr:lcd_sd_3v3 and gpio0 as pwr:ext_ldo.

facts.label: RTC
facts.notes: Official PinMap "RTC-BM8563" rows. M5GFX m5tough.json does not list an rtc device even though M5Tough::begin() calls Rtc.begin(); the board model therefore keeps the RTC on the official page as the authority.

facts.label: PSRAM
facts.notes: M5GFX dev:psram.cs=G16 / dev:psram.clk=G17 for the 8MB quad PSRAM named in the official specification table.

facts.label: microSD slot
facts.notes: Official PinMap row; Config.h sets TFCARD_CS_PIN 4 and M5Tough::begin() calls SD.begin(TFCARD_CS_PIN, SPI, 40000000). M5GFX adds sd.d3 = G4.

facts.label: External I2C (Grove Port A)
facts.notes: Official HY2.0-4P row for PORT.A and M5Tough::begin() Wire.begin(32,33); the Ext Board schematic labels J1 pin 1 IIC_SCL = GPIO33 and pin 2 IIC_SDA = GPIO32. The ESP32 GPIO numbers are fixed, unlike the older Core Basic where Port A sits on the host board.

facts.label: Console UART and USB bridge

value.usb_bridge: CH9102 (current official page) / CP2104-F03-GMR (2021 schematic, U3)

facts.notes: Version conflict kept explicit: the current page lists CH9102 (with CH9102 driver downloads) while the audited schematic export and the library README show a CP2104. M5GFX models usb_serial part ch9102 with auto_reset true and console_uart tx G1 / rx G3.

facts.label: RS485 interface

value.direction_control: auto-direction; DE/RE are combined with TX through Q1, no separate GPIO

facts.notes: Ext Board schematic J4 = HY-2.0_RS485 (pin 1 B, pin 2 A, pin 3 +24V, pin 4 GND) plus M5GFX tough_subboard accessory, which is marked verified against the datasheet. The official page only publishes the row "M5-Bus G27 G19 (DC-DC 6 ~ 24V->5V) GND".

facts.label: HY2.0-4P ports on the Ext Board
facts.notes: Official HY2.0-4P table gives colour order (Black=GND, Red=5V, then the two signal wires); the M5GFX board_spec README defines hy2_4p signal positions 1/2, so the colour list and the position list run in opposite order and both are recorded. J2 = HY-2.0_IO (1=in GPIO36, 2=out GPIO26) and J3 = HY-2.0_UART (1=RX GPIO13, 2=TX GPIO14) from the Ext Board schematic.

facts.label: M5-Bus power terminals

value.note: the host board leaves the HPWR terminals unconnected; the bundled Ext Board feeds HPWR into the ME3116 input

facts.notes: Official M5-Bus table rows 25-30 combined with the Ext Board schematic (HPWR x3 nets) and the M5GFX mbus connector note.

facts.label: Difference from Core2 (K010)

value.touch: Tough CHSC6540 @0x2E, y_max 239; Core2 FT5X06/FT6336U @0x38, y_max 279
value.lcd_selection: Tough runtime-selected ili9342c/ili9342e; Core2 selected by board revision
same_on_both: internal I2C G21/G22 with AXP192 and BM8563
speaker G12/G0/G2 with SPK_EN on AXP_IO2
Grove A G32/G33, B G26/G36, C G14/G13

facts.notes: Compared in the same M5GFX revision (28d47949bdc84f30881623476f555398e2194313) plus the current official pages. Tough adds RS485 with a 6-24V input and a 30-pin M5-Bus with HPWR; Core2 has no RS485 rail.

facts.label: Difference from Core Basic (K007)

value.buttons: K007 BtnA/BtnB/BtnC are real GPIO inputs (G39/G38/G37); Tough has no GPIO buttons and uses touch zones
value.display: K007 LCD CS G14, DC G27, RST G33, backlight G32 (PWM), SPI MISO G19; Tough CS G5, DC G15, reset on AXP_IO4, SPI MISO G38
value.speaker: K007 speaker data_out G25; Tough NS4168 data_out G2 with enable on AXP_IO2
value.power: K007 has no AXP192; Tough power rails and panel reset are AXP192 outputs
value.touch: K007 resistive XPT2046-class panel; Tough CHSC6540 capacitive on I2C 0x2E

facts.notes: M5GFX boards/m5stack.json compared against boards/m5tough.json. Recorded so the classic line order in Config.h (TFT_CS 14, TFT_DC 27, TFT_RST 33, TFT_LED 32, MISO 19) is never inherited by the Tough model.

facts.label: Difference from Tough-C5

value.chip: Tough-C5 is ESP32-C5 (M5GFX legacy_board_id 33) with M5PM1 PMIC and an M5IOE1 I/O expander; K034 is ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 with AXP192
value.display: Tough-C5 LCD CS G25, DC G26; K034 LCD CS G5, DC G15
value.ports: Tough-C5 Grove ports arrive through an internal expansion board

facts.notes: Fetched to prevent name-based inheritance: the two boards share the "Tough" name only. m5toughc5.json pin assignments are not applicable to m5stack-k034.

facts.label: CHSC6540 read protocol

value.read: write pointer 0x02, restart, 1 point-count byte then points*6-2 bytes
value.int_pin: G39 reads low while a touch is pending

facts.notes: Register-level behaviour taken from the pinned M5GFX driver and cross-checked against the deprecated M5Tough library. It describes what the emulator must answer on I2C; it is not a measurement of the shipped part.

facts.label: Front key identifiers

value.transport: CHSC6540 touch zone, no ESP32 GPIO

facts.notes: Stable catalog identifiers for the five press controls. The left/middle/right order follows the deprecated library BtnA/BtnB/BtnC zones (M5Button.h line 268-273) and the printed circles in the product photos; no official source publishes per-key touch coordinates, so the geometry stays an approximation.

facts.label: Tough Tools diagnostic firmware
facts.notes: The exact K034 M5Burner project and manufacturer product links identify Tough Tools as a device diagnostic. The product page, linked source, and the official Tough M5Burner listings reviewed here do not establish an image used at the factory.

M5GFX Touch_CHSC6540.hpp (driver declaration)
sources.notes: Sets _cfg.i2c_addr 0x2e and the raw window x_max 319 / y_max 239 for the CHSC6540 touch controller.

sources.title: M5GFX Touch_CHSC6540.inl (driver implementation)
sources.notes: init() writes 0x5A 0x5A to switch to INT mode; getTouchRaw() returns early when the INT pin reads high, then writes register pointer 0x02, restarts, reads one point-count byte and points*6-2 further bytes; x = (b0&0x0F)<<8|b1, y = (b2&0x0F)<<8|b3. Matches the deprecated M5Tough library (Wire1 21/22, 0x2E, register 0x5A write, digitalRead(39)==LOW).

unknowns.label: User hardware revision
unknowns.notes: Catalog identity does not infer the revision owned by the user.

unknowns.label: PCB physical layout
unknowns.notes: No complete populated PCB layout or Gerber verified in the audited files. A manufacturer mechanical board outline, when present, does not establish every component or copper trace. Unknown internals remain a neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.

unknowns.label: Built-in battery
unknowns.notes: The main schematic contains BT1 with BATT / SYS_VBAT / RTC_BAT nets and the Ext Board schematic has a BATTERY net on M5-Bus position 30; the deprecated library README claims a 390mAh battery, while the current official specification table lists no battery and no capacity. Type, capacity and whether the reviewed revision is populated are unverified.

unknowns.label: Vibration motor
unknowns.notes: Claimed by the library README ("built-in vibration motor") but absent from the current official specification table and from M5GFX m5tough.json. No official Tough pin-map row exists for it.

unknowns.label: Green power indicator LED
unknowns.notes: The README describes a green LED power indicator fed by AXP_IO1; the current official Tough page has no such row, and M5GFX lists a power_led only for Core2. Whether a Tough revision populates it is unverified.

unknowns.label: Touch panel reset source
unknowns.notes: Three authorities disagree: the README assigns TouchPanel RST to AXP_IO1, the official page assigns CHSC6540 RST to AXP_IO4, and the schematic exposes only one LCD_RST net on AXP192 GPIO4. The model treats the panel as sharing the LCD reset, but no board-level measurement has confirmed the touch controller reset timing.

unknowns.label: Factory firmware image
unknowns.notes: No bootable factory image has been verified for this SKU yet. The official page offers UiFlow1/UiFlow2/Arduino entries and MTools/EasyLoader download portals; the survey result is recorded in web/platform/catalog/firmwares.json and docs/platform/evidence/tough/ once a fixed URL and SHA-256 exist.

collectionNotes: Specification and pin-map rows preserve factual parameters from the exact documented product, not sibling SKUs.
Raw full official page/PDF downloads stay temporary; images and manufacturer CAD retain distinct rights.
Model import does not establish CPU/board/peripheral firmware support.

Sources are pinned: the current official page (SHA-256 d7f1c8421e21...) dated 2026-11-22, the 2021-01-22 Altium schematic exports, M5GFX board_spec at 28d47949bdc84f30881623476f555398e2194313 and the deprecated M5Tough library at 2dc8ad313f13d64da8aaaa1c8a448e2862ddadee. Conflicts between them are recorded instead of averaged.

The official page and the 2021 schematic disagree on the USB serial bridge (CH9102 versus CP2104-F03-GMR) and the 2026-10-26 page disagreed with the current page on the LCD backlight rail (AXP_DC3 versus AXP_LDO3). Neither is silently merged.

M5Tough Config.h carries the classic M5Stack line order (TFT_CS 14, TFT_DC 27, TFT_RST 33, TFT_LED 32, MISO 19). Those defaults do not apply to Tough and were not used; only the microSD CS 4 matches the official page.
M5GFX pmic.pins for m5tough has no verified marker, so gpio3 -> lcd.rst is kept as a recorded disagreement with the official page and schematic.
Library README statements about a 390mAh battery, vibration motor, green power LED and CP2104 are older-revision claims; they are held as unknowns for this SKU until an official source supports them.
